scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='frontend/dist'; const dest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/dist-frontend'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true, force: true}); const mSrc='desktop/main.cjs'; const mDest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/main.cjs'; if (fs.existsSync(mSrc) && fs.existsSync('desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app')) fs.copyFileSync(mSrc, mDest);"
scripts.sync-desktop: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='frontend/dist'; const dest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/dist-frontend'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true, force: true}); const mSrc='desktop/main.cjs'; const mDest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/main.cjs'; if (fs.existsSync(mSrc) && fs.existsSync('desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app')) fs.copyFileSync(mSrc, mDest);"
